summary: BI-B986A18B: additive consent binding and indexed credential families. Existing rows stay unbound. No new secret material or copied personal attributes. Revoke rather than rewrite consent; rollback preserves restrictive validation and revocations. No data deletion or backfill. Affected copies are install-local PostgreSQL and its existing backup policy. Migration and live acceptance remain pending.
